curl 8.22.0 (libcurl only)

Source:   https://github.com/curl/curl/releases/tag/curl-8_22_0
Asset:    curl-8.22.0.tar.xz (2,953,092 bytes)
Released: 2026-09-02
SHA-256:  f7ef3ae8a22e521f289803fe93543eb64c329b58aa73a9e224dfd915a2a5f4f7
Checked 2026-09-29 before vendoring: the SHA-256 matches GitHub's asset
digest, and curl-8.22.0.tar.xz.asc is a GOOD signature from Daniel
Stenberg's release key, fingerprint
27ED EAF2 2F3A BCEB 50DB 9A12 5CC9 08FD B71E 12C2.

Vendored: COPYING, include/ and lib/ from the tarball, unchanged, PLUS one
Softanza-owned file, lib/curl_config.h (not upstream -- see below).

HISTORY. Vendored 2026-06-14 as an 8.20.0-DEV snapshot (869cb4a89) with
one local patch to lib/easy.c (53bac329f): Curl_win32_init before
Curl_ssl_init, without which Schannel's ALPN gate read a lying OS version
and HTTP/2 silently fell back to 1.1. Moved to the 8.22.0 RELEASE on
2026-09-29 by the stzlib-security plane. The patch is NOT carried: 8.22.0
already initializes Win32 before SSL upstream, and 71_http2_narrated
proves h2 still negotiates.

WHAT 8.22 CHANGED FOR THIS BUILD, and would change silently again:
  - resolver sources moved to lib/vdns/; build.zig addLibcurl globs a
    fixed list of lib folders, so a new folder is sources not built --
    lib/vdns was added to the list.
  - lib/config-win32.h now #errors outside Visual Studio 2010-2013 IDE
    builds. lib/curl_config.h is the 8.20 snapshot's config-win32.h kept
    unchanged, selected with -DHAVE_CONFIG_H.

UPDATING: take COPYING, include/ and lib/ from a newer release (keep
lib/curl_config.h), verify the tarball's digest and signature, check
lib/ for new folders and lib/config-win32.h for new defines, rebuild,
and run base/test/network/ (52-71, 71 is HTTP/2) and engine/tools/sbom.py.
